title: Bridge Between RJDemetra (v2) and rjd3 (v3)
text: rjd3bridge R package designed bridge gap RJDemetra (based JDemetra+ version 2) modern rjd3 package suite (rjd3x13 rjd3tramoseats, based JDemetra+ version 3). provides bidirectional conversion tools (as_rjd2() as_rjd3() functions) seamlessly translate seasonal adjustment specifications fitted model objects across ecosystem versions without needing rewrite custom configurations scratch.

title: Bridge Between RJDemetra (v2) and rjd3 (v3)
code: library(rjd3bridge) y <- RJDemetra::ipi_c_eu[, "FR"] model_v2 <- RJDemetra::x13(y, spec = "RSA5c") model_v3 <- as_rjd3(model_v2)  # Convert only a specification object spec_v2 <- RJDemetra::x13_spec("RSA5c") spec_v3 <- as_rjd3(spec_v2)

title: Bridge Between RJDemetra (v2) and rjd3 (v3)
text: modelling_context provided specification contains user-defined variables. Otherwise, conversion complete: preprocessing models (RegARIMA TRAMO), input time series y must provided conversion function. Otherwise start date time series default year 1, may lead incorrect results (e.g., outliers).
code: library(rjd3bridge) y <- rjd3toolkit::ABS$X0.2.09.10.M model_v3 <- rjd3x13::x13(y) model_v2 <- as_rjd2(model_v3) library(rjd3bridge) y <- rjd3toolkit::ABS$X0.2.09.10.M regs_td <- rjd3toolkit::td(   s = y,   groups = c(1, 2, 0, 4, 5, 6, 3),   contrasts = TRUE )  variables <- list(r = list(   Monday = regs_td[, 1],   Tuesday = regs_td[, 2],   Wednesday = regs_td[, 3],   Thursday = regs_td[, 4],   Friday = regs_td[, 5],   Saturday = regs_td[, 6] )) my_context <- rjd3toolkit::modelling_context(variables = variables) spec <- rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats_spec() |>    rjd3toolkit::set_tradingdays(   option = "UserDefined",   uservariable = c("r.Monday", "r.Tuesday", "r.Wednesday",                    "r.Thursday", "r.Friday", "r.Saturday"),   test = "None" ) model_v3 <- rjd3tramoseats::tramoseats(y, spec, my_context) model_v2 <- as_rjd2(model_v3, context = my_context) model_v3 <- rjd3tramoseats::tramo(y) as_rjd2(model_v3) #> y = regression model + arima (0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 1) #> Log-transformation: yes #> Coefficients: #>           Estimate Std. Error #> Theta(1)   -1.1304      0.047 #> Theta(2)    0.3088      0.047 #> BTheta(1)  -0.6523      0.037 #>  #>             Estimate Std. Error #> Mean      -3.044e-05          0 #> Week days -6.643e-04          0 #>  #>  #> Residual standard error: 0.00614 on 406 degrees of freedom #> Log likelihood =  1510, aic = -1410 aicc = -1409, bic(corrected for length) = -10.11 as_rjd2(model_v3, y = y) #> y = regression model + arima (0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1) #> Log-transformation: yes #> Coefficients: #>           Estimate Std. Error #> Theta(1)   -0.8278      0.028 #> BTheta(1)  -0.4255      0.045 #>  #>               Estimate Std. Error #> Monday      -0.0109445      0.003 #> Tuesday      0.0048940      0.004 #> Wednesday    0.0001761      0.003 #> Thursday     0.0132928      0.004 #> Friday      -0.0024801      0.004 #> Saturday     0.0153509      0.004 #> Leap year    0.0410667      0.010 #> Easter [6]   0.0503888      0.007 #> AO (7-2000) -0.1972355      0.030 #> AO (6-2000)  0.1681679      0.030 #>  #>  #> Residual standard error: 0.03616 on 399 degrees of freedom #> Log likelihood = 781.4, aic =  4199 aicc =  4199, bic(corrected for length) = -6.464

title: Convert 'rjd3' Objects to 'RJDemetra' (v2) Format — as_rjd2
text: Converts seasonal adjustment models, outputs, specifications modern 'rjd3' ecosystem (JDemetra+ v3) back legacy 'RJDemetra' (JDemetra+ v2) objects backward compatibility legacy reporting workflows.

title: Convert 'rjd3' Objects to 'RJDemetra' (v2) Format — as_rjd2
code: as_rjd2(x, ...)  # S3 method for class 'JD3_TRAMOSEATS_SPEC' as_rjd2(x, context = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'JD3_TRAMO_SPEC' as_rjd2(x, context = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'JD3_TRAMOSEATS_OUTPUT' as_rjd2(   x,   context = NULL,   specification = c("estimation_spec", "result_spec"),   ... )  # S3 method for class 'JD3_TRAMO_OUTPUT' as_rjd2(   x,   context = NULL,   specification = c("estimation_spec", "result_spec"),   y = NULL,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'JD3_X13_SPEC' as_rjd2(x, context = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'JD3_REGARIMA_SPEC' as_rjd2(x, context = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'JD3_X11_SPEC' as_rjd2(x, context = NULL, ...)  # S3 method for class 'JD3_X13_OUTPUT' as_rjd2(   x,   context = NULL,   specification = c("estimation_spec", "result_spec"),   ... )  # S3 method for class 'JD3_REGARIMA_OUTPUT' as_rjd2(   x,   context = NULL,   specification = c("estimation_spec", "result_spec"),   y = NULL,   ... )

title: Convert 'rjd3' Objects to 'RJDemetra' (v2) Format — as_rjd2
text: x object 'rjd3' ecosystem (e.g., packages rjd3x13 rjd3tramoseats). ... Additional arguments passed specific methods. context Optional rjd3toolkit::modelling_context()  containing user-defined variables. specification specification seasonal adjustment model use conversion. Can "estimation_spec" (default, specification used estimate model), "result_spec" (specification used produce final results). y Input time series data. Needed as_rjd2.JD3_REGARIMA_OUTPUT() as_rjd2.JD3_TRAMO_OUTPUT(). provided, default year default equal 1.
